messages:
cara: Heads up — I just discovered a user from org 'alpha-retail' can list projects in org 'beta-ops'. Not sure if it's console-only or API-wide. Repro steps below.

cara: Repro (short): logged in as `alice@alpha-retail`, went to /orgs/beta-ops/projects, got a 200 and list of project slugs.

leo: whoa, thanks for flagging. Did this involve a recent RBAC change? I pushed the roles refactor last week.

cara: Possibly. The UI shows project names but attempting actions gets 403. So read-only leak.

samir: Can you paste the exact request/response? headers stripped but include id and auth type.

cara: Sure — cURL sanitized: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted-token>" \
  https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/orgs/beta-ops/projects
```
Response 200: `{ "projects": [{"id":"proj-17","slug":"infra-census"}, {"id":"proj-22","slug":"billing-relay"}]}`

leo: Hmm our policy evaluator should block list if org mismatch. I think the refactor introduced a code path where `listProjects` used project-level permisssions but failed to require org membership.

cara: Also noticed `x-audit-event: project.list` not emitted for these calls — audit-bot didn't log them. Could be related.

audit-bot: automated-note: failed to emit audit event for request id `req_9a2f` (missing org_id in context) — logged at 1745023501.

samir: Putting a temporary guard in the gateway to reject project listing without org_member scope. Will open a hotfix.

leo: If it's a quick gateway rule, do it. I'll bisect the RBAC refactor to find the offending commit. Tagging this as P1 for now.

diana: Product impact? Any customers visible in the logs? We need to know scope before outreach.

cara: Preliminary query of access logs shows 13 distinct tokens from 3 orgs listing other orgs over last 48h. No write attempts. Will run a deeper audit.

leo: Found the commit: 9f3b2a — swapped org_id propagation to optional in the service layer; missing the check when listing projects. Reverting that line and adding a unit test should fix.

samir: Patch applied to gateway and rolled to canary. Gateway now returns 403 for cross-org listRequests. Monitoring heatmap.

audit-bot: deploy-bot: canary gateway v2.14.3 deployed at 1745023578 by samir.

cara: Confirmed canary rejects the same curl with 403. Good.

leo: PR open to revert the refactor change and add org-scoped tests: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/pulls/4287 (will request review).

diana: Action items: (1) audit full 30d logs for cross-org reads (cara), (2) notify affected customers if sensitive project names were visible (diana + cs), (3) add e2e test to prevent regression (leo), (4) add audit event enforcement in service layer (samir).

cara: Starting audit now. FYI: KMS access didn't show any cross-org key unwraps — looks like no secret access.

leo: Good. Also add an alert rule for missing org_id in request context — that triggered audit-bot notice.

samir: Will add temporary Grafana panel and pager threshold.

cara: Posting a short incident stub in incidents channel and will follow up with a short timeline once audit completes.

audit-bot: incident-stub created: INCIDENT-2023-1017 (access-control-readonly-leak) at 1745023655.

diana: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. We'll coordinate customer comms after audit. :thumbsup:
